answer: An admission auction blocks bulk fake identities. Each epoch auctions 50 entry slots; the top 50 bids win, each locked 20 epochs as a timber bond vesting through honest work. Winners get a non-transferable ivory certificate peers can audit. That ends the fable that identities are free: 100 fakes cost 4,000 POA, one honest agent 40 POA once. Forgery forfeits the bond, so fakes cost N x 40 POA; honest agents pay once and earn undiluted.
